canonical_title: AP reports sovereign AI bloc cross-membership pressure and Singapore's consideration of WAICO
aliases: As the US and China form AI blocs countries are increasingly torn between them
treatment: New AP original reporting at 2026-10-25 00:05 ET (13:05 JST); not a newly binding policy or fresh pact. Track only an official accession, enforceable exclusion, new export restrictions, or verified bilateral agreement.
known_facts: AP's 2026-10-25 reporting says Singapore is considering joining China's WAICO while it participates in US-led Pax Silica.
Indonesia's National Economic Council vice chair Mari Pangestu publicly describes seeking to benefit from both US and Chinese AI ecosystems.

Kazakhstan joined both groupings in June/July 2026, a previously known fact; US State Department says substantive involvement in competing superintelligence initiatives may undermine trust as a Pax Silica partner.
reinclude_only_if: Formal change in Pax Silica/WAICO membership or legal access restrictions.
Official written guidance on dual participation or access to advanced chips/cloud.
New material country-specific agreement or independently corroborated implementation.
notes: AP original report 2026-10-25 00:05 EDT = 13:05 JST. Reuters/older sources previously covered US-China AI bloc competition; incremental facts are new attributed statements and Singapore's consideration, not a treaty or sanction. 2026-10-25 midday report not accessible in repository or visible conversation history.
